answers.evidence:
Reproduced the bug first — with a valid `.env` present, `go run ./cmd/asce-api` panicked exactly as reported:

```
panic: required environment variable DATABASE_URL is not set
```

After the fix, verified end-to-end:

| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| `make run` with `.env` (32-byte key) | `connecting to database postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/asce?sslmode=disable`, exit 0 |
| `DATABASE_URL` exported + conflicting `.env` | env value wins — `postgres://container:...` (no-override semantics for container `env_file`) |
| No `.env`, no env vars | still panics `required environment variable DATABASE_URL is not set` (correct guard, exit 2) |
| 24-byte placeholder in `.env` | rejected: `APP_KEY must be exactly 32 bytes, got 24` |
| 32-byte placeholder in `.env` | accepted |

Tests: `go test ./... -v` — 4 top-level test functions, all PASS (including subtests: 5 cases):

```
=== RUN   TestLoad_EnvOverridesDotenv            --- PASS
=== RUN   TestLoad_NoDotenvFile                  --- PASS
=== RUN   TestLoad_EnvFileMissingRequiredStillPanics --- PASS
=== RUN   TestLoad_AppKeyLengthValidation        --- PASS (2/2 subtests)
ok  	asce-api/internal/config
```

`go vet ./...` clean; `go mod tidy` resolved `github.com/joho/godotenv v1.5.1` into `go.mod`/`go.sum`.
